question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN t.customer_id END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id), 0),
  2) AS eur_customer_pct
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = '2012-08-25'
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-25'
